name: Haunted Aiudara
disable: DC 25 Religion check (trained) to exorcise one of the wraiths or DC 25 Occultism check (expert) to erase one of the wraith's astral sigils; three successful checks are required to disable the haunt
reset: The aiudara wraiths disperse after 1 minute, but the haunt resets after 24 hours.
routine:
(3 actions; conjuration, divine, teleportation) With spectral claws, the aiudara wraiths hurl trespassers through time and space. Each of the three wraiths has 1 action which it can use to make a forceful hand Strike against a creature within 60 feet. The haunt loses 1 action for each successful check to disable the haunt.
When the haunt rolls a critical hit to Strike a creature, the creature is instantly shunted to an empty space within 30 feet. The haunt chooses which space the creature is transported to.

items.name: Forceful Screech
items.text:
Trigger A creature comes within 30 feet of the aiudara

---
Effect Three aiudara wraiths screech in unison and manifest to protect the arch. Each creature within 30 feet must attempt a DC 27 Will save save. The haunt rolls initiative.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature takes 2d8+9 force damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes 4d8+9 force damage and is Fatigued.

text: The spiritual imprints of long-dead explorers haunt this aiudara, manifesting as a trio of astral wraiths who guard the gateway jealously.
